events.title: Next Fest is live — here's how to read your first fight
events.summary: Next Fest: Oct 19 – Oct 26 HOSHIKIRI is in Steam Next Fest until Oct 26 at 10 AM PT. The demo has been free since September 30, so if you already have it, you're ready to go. Your first fight, in thirty seconds Aries opens Act One. When she winds up, a danger zone lights up on the board, and a rule line at the top tells you how to block it. events.summary: This week's house: Gemini Gemini raises both hands. And only one of the two blades is real. Reading the telegraph Two blades, one real. The rule line says it outright: TWIN BLADES - ONE IS REAL: DODGE INSIDE IT. Answer the real one. events.title: Boss of the week: Taurus, and why a line can't block her hammer
events.summary: Boss of the week: Taurus One Zodiac boss per week, shown in motion. Week two is Taurus, the second fight of act one in HOSHIKIRI, an action match-3 roguelike built around the parry. Her hammer paints an area. When she raises it, the red covers a 4x4 patch of the board. Against Aries you blocked with a straight three along her line. events.title: Boss of the week: Aries, and the countdown UI is gone
events.summary: Boss of the week: Aries Starting this week, one Zodiac boss per week. Aries goes first, because she is the first fight of act one and the easiest of the twelve to read. Her danger zone is a line. When she winds up, the red paints one row or one column across the board. A line is the friendliest shape in the game: a cross or an L fits entirely inside it, the whole shape counts, and the parry registers perfect. Break her posture that way and the overclock window opens — one action, no step spent.

events.title: Every match is a sword stroke — welcome to HOSHIKIRI
events.summary: Every match is a sword stroke. Welcome to the HOSHIKIRI community hub. This is the first dev post, so here is what the game is in one loop: the boss winds up, the danger zone lights up on the board, you shape an L or a cross inside it, and a perfect parry breaks her posture. Then you end it in one overclocked blow. What is coming next: A free demo (the first four Zodiac bosses) for Steam Next Fest, October 19-26. A trailer before the press preview on October 8.
